403	- Claims lint passes — it does not (§5).
404	- Says DOMPurify is blocked pending approval — it was added anyway (§4.1).
405	- Lists paths that don't exist: `overrides/app/ui-kits/atoms/zimmPageToolbar.tsx` (actual: `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmPageToolbar/index.tsx`).
406	- Tier table omits `package.json` (Tier 1), `package-lock.json` (Tier 1), `theme/components/index.ts` + `theme/components/pdpProductInfo.ts` (Tier 2, UI Designer), `scripts/generateRegistry.mjs`, `.claude/registry/*`, `types/commerce.ts`, `types/index.ts`, `utils/productData.ts`, `pages/product-detail/index.test.ts`.
407	- Says "9 scenarios" — there are 10.
408	
409	### Open CodeRabbit findings at HEAD
410	Latest review `2026-08-21T18:14:38Z` is **after** HEAD (`2026-08-21T04:31 +08:00` = `2026-08-20T20:31Z`), so it applies to the current code. Still-open items:
411	
412	| Severity | Location | Finding |
413	|---|---|---|
414	| 🟠 Major | `package.json:118` | Obtain Integration/SI approval before merging the dependency |
415	| 🟠 Major | `e2e/fixtures/products.js:29` | Remove the cross-site standard-product fallback |
416	| 🟠 Major | `scripts/generateRegistry.mjs:502` | Version the consumer-count caches with the matcher |
417	| 🟡 Minor | `product-detail/index.tsx:90` | Set PDP document metadata (Helmet/Seo) |
418	| 🟡 Minor | `product-detail/index.tsx:40` | `parentCategoryTree` / `levels` semantics |

421	| 🟡 Minor | `generateRegistry.mjs:404` | (union-parse edge case) |
422	
423	Per `AGENTS.md` > *Responding to a CodeRabbit PR review*, **every** finding needs an explicit in-thread reply whether or not it is fixed. Worth checking on takeover whether the earlier (18 Aug / 20 Aug) findings got replies or just fix-commits.
424	
425	---
426	
427	## 7. Honest overall assessment
428	
429	**Verdict: a solid *component* base sitting on an unsafe *integration*. Keep the components, rework the page and the two override-shadow decisions.**
430	
431	### What is genuinely good — keep it
432	- **`PdpProductInfo` + its theme recipe is exemplary.** Correct `useMultiStyleConfig` pattern, `Zimm`-prefixed and registered, every escape hatch documented with a written exit path. This is the pattern the rest of the branch should be migrated to.
433	- **Accessibility was taken seriously and is real, not claimed.** `h1` for the product name, `nav`/`ol`/`li` breadcrumb semantics, `aria-current="page"`, `aria-hidden` separators, and a Storybook `play` that actually asserts tab order (`breadcrumb/index.stories.tsx:46-52`).
434	- **Storybook coverage is complete and correctly categorised** — all four surfaces, `play` functions only where there's interaction.
435	- **Gherkin-first E2E workflow followed** — `.feature` before spec, correct `@pdp`/`@SFCC-89` tags on all 10 tests, sensible page-object locators using accessible selectors first.
436	- **The `generateRegistry.mjs` consumer-count fix is a real, well-reasoned improvement** (specifier anchoring instead of substring grep, plus a single file-walk instead of N subprocesses). It happens to be unrelated to SFCC-89.
437	- **`tsc` and Vitest are green.**
438	
439	### What makes it not mergeable as-is
440	1. **A Tier 1 file was changed after the PR body itself said it was blocked pending approval.** That is the single most serious thing here — not because dompurify is wrong (it's the right call for `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`), but because the process gate was identified and then walked through. It also drags in 16 MB / jsdom on the SSR path with no bundle-budget verification.
441	2. **Merging this removes add-to-bag and all SEO metadata from the PDP.** Whether that's in scope for "static product information" is a product question no one has answered in the PR. It cannot merge to `develop` without an explicit answer.
442	3. **The `Breadcrumb` override silently restyles the PLP.** It shadows a shared SFCC component and is not a faithful port — the PLP breadcrumb loses its chevron separators and its theme config. Nobody asked for that and the PR body doesn't mention the PLP at all.
443	4. **The `Pages/PDP` story is a copy-paste of the page**, so the one artefact reviewers will actually look at is not the thing being reviewed.
444	
445	### Effort to make it good
446	Roughly a day of focused work, and it is mostly *decisions*, not code:
447	
448	- **10 minutes:** `npm run lint:fix` (all 5 errors auto-fixable); delete the redundant `.gitkeep` and the dead `: null`.
449	- **Half a day:** move `Breadcrumb` and `ZimmPageToolbar` styling into `theme/components/*.ts` recipes (the author already knows how — `3e1686b` is the template); `react-intl` the four hardcoded strings; make `ZimmPageToolbar`'s padding responsive; add the missing per-site SKUs or a hard configuration error.
450	- **Half a day:** extract a presentational `PdpLayout` so the page and the story stop duplicating; add a Vitest for the breadcrumb-assembly/degradation logic; move `index.test.ts` → `utils/productData.test.ts`.
451	- **Blocking, needs humans not code:** Integration sign-off on `isomorphic-dompurify` (or swap for a lighter sanitizer); a product/Squad-A decision on the base-PDP replacement scope; UI Designer notification for the two Tier 2 theme files; a squad-lead call on the PDP ownership move.
452	
453	### Takeover recommendation
454	Do **not** rebase-and-continue on top of this. Land the four blocking decisions first — dependency approval, PDP replacement scope, breadcrumb-shadow strategy, theme-file owner sign-off — because two of them (scope, breadcrumb) may delete or restructure a meaningful slice of the code. The component layer (`PdpProductInfo`, `ZimmPageToolbar`, the stories, the `.feature`) is worth carrying forward almost verbatim.

## 3. Component-by-component assessment

### 3.1 `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` — **Override of base PDP**

### 3.2 `overrides/app/components/breadcrumb/index.tsx` — **Override of base SFCC breadcrumb**

- **Renders:** `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"><ol>` with a hardcoded `Home` crumb, mapped category links, `/` text separators (`aria-hidden`), and a non-link terminal crumb with `aria-current="page"`.

- **Data fetching:** no. Correct per `components.md` > Composition.
- **Story:** yes — 4 stories, one with a `play` asserting focus order and `aria-current`. Good quality.
- **Test:** no Vitest (not needed — the `play` covers it).

### 3.3 `overrides/app/components/pdpProductInfo/index.tsx` — Zimmermann-authored

- **Renders:** `h1` name, `p` price, sanitized-HTML description, optional sanitized model info, optional `Style Code: {styleCode}`.
- **Props:** `name: string`, `price: string`, `description?`, `modelInfo?`, `styleCode?`.
- **Data fetching:** no. Correct.
- **Story:** yes — 2 stories, one with `play` asserting the optional fields are absent.
- **Test:** no direct test.
- **Best file on the branch.** All styling in the theme recipe consumed via `useMultiStyleConfig('ZimmPdpProductInfo')` (`:27`), only the two conditional margins at the call site with an explanatory comment block (`:14-20`). `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` correctly wrapped in `DOMPurify.sanitize()` at `:43` and `:54` — satisfies `conventions.md` and the `semgrep.yml` rule.

### 3.4 `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmPageToolbar/index.tsx`

- **Renders:** a padded, `background.07` wrapper; `breadcrumbs` variant wraps children at `opacity 0.8`; the other two render an `h2` heading + optional CTA link.

- **Location** matches the decided `ui-kits/{atoms,molecules,organisms}/<camelCase>/` structure.

### 3.5 `overrides/app/utils/productData.ts`

## 4. Rule violations

### 4.1 🔴 Tier 1 file modified without documented approval — `package.json`

`AGENTS.md` Hard Rule #2 + Hard Rule #7; `.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md` > *Runtime & Integration Config* names `package.json (root)`.

```diff
  "contentful": "^11.12.4",
+ "isomorphic-dompurify": "^3.19.0"
```
`package.json:118`

Three compounding problems:

1. **The PR body itself says this is blocked.** It reads: *"DOMPurify is not in `package.json` and needs integration team approval (Hard Rule #7). ... Please raise a follow-up ticket and get integration team approval before the next sprint."* Commit `0068e1a` then added it anyway. No approval is recorded anywhere in the PR.
2. **The PR body's own tier table omits `package.json` entirely** — it lists 15 files, all classified Tier 2/3/4. Tier 1 is not mentioned.
3. **Size.** Installed footprint is **16 MB** (`isomorphic-dompurify`), pulling **jsdom (12 MB)** for the SSR path. It is imported at module scope in `pdpProductInfo/index.tsx:2`, i.e. on the PDP critical path and in the SSR bundle. `AGENTS.md` > Performance > *Bundle size*: "Do not introduce large dependencies without confirming with the user"; > *Dependencies*: "check `package.json` for what is already installed ... present the recommendation ... and wait for user approval before installing anything." No existing sanitizer was evaluated — grep confirms this is the first `sanitize`/`DOMPurify` usage anywhere in `overrides/`.
   **Unverified risk:** `test:max-file-size` budgets are `main.js ≤ 180 kB` / `vendor.js ≤ 550 kB`. I did not run a build (too slow for this audit) — this needs checking before merge.

CodeRabbit independently flagged this as Major on `package.json:118`: *"Obtain Integration / SI Partner approval before merging this dependency change."* Still open.

### 4.2 🔴 Hard Rule #10 — change spans three protection tiers

`AGENTS.md` Hard Rule #10: *"Never touch more than one protection tier in a single change without stopping to confirm scope with the developer."* This PR touches Tier 1 (`package.json`, `package-lock.json`), Tier 2 (`routes.tsx`, both theme files), and untiered code. The PR body's tier table omits **both** Tier 1 files **and both** Tier 2 theme files (`theme/components/index.ts`, `theme/components/pdpProductInfo.ts` — owner: **UI Designer**, who has not been notified per `protectedFiles.md`).

### 4.3 🟠 The base SFCC PDP is silently replaced

`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/` shadows `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/product-detail/`, **and** `overrides/app/routes.tsx:37-40` registers `/product/:productId` *before* the `..._routes` spread — so the override wins the route match over base `routes.jsx:110`.

The base PDP that this replaces imports and renders: `ProductView` (image gallery, swatch group, quantity picker, **add-to-cart**, wishlist), `RecommendedProducts` (×3 zones), `InformationAccordion`, `Island`, Einstein/DataCloud/ActiveData analytics, `useServerContext` + `HTTPNotFound`/`HTTPError` for correct SSR status codes, `Helmet` for document metadata, and `MAX_CACHE_AGE`/`STALE_WHILE_REVALIDATE` cache headers.

The override renders **none of it** — the gallery is a grey `<Box>` placeholder at `index.tsx:56`.

This may well be the intended scope of a story called "static product information," but as written, merging to `develop` removes **add-to-bag from the storefront**. `AGENTS.md` > Rules > *Minimal changes*: "Do not remove or replace existing base template functionality unless explicitly instructed." Nothing in the PR body acknowledges this.

Related, independently flagged by CodeRabbit at `product-detail/index.tsx:90`: **no `<Seo>` / `Helmet`** — no `<title>`, no meta description, no canonical on a product page. `AGENTS.md` opening line: "Must be robust and secure and **SEO-friendly**." `overrides/app/components/seo/` is Tier 2 and available.

Also absent vs. base: no `useServerContext().res.status(404)` for an unknown SKU. `product-detail/index.tsx:65-66` renders a plain error `<Text>` with an HTTP 200. Bad for SEO and for `graceful degradation`.

### 4.4 🟠 The `Breadcrumb` override breaks the SFCC bridge contract

`.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` > *The SFCC bridge pattern (shared components only)*: if a component is used internally by SFCC's own base components, its **default export must stay a faithful, undecorated port** — full original prop surface, brand styling behind a named export.

Base `app/components/breadcrumb` **is** a shared internal dependency — two base consumers:
- `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-view/index.jsx:75` → `<Breadcrumb categories={category} />`
- `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/product-list/partials/page-header.jsx:20` → `<Breadcrumb categories={category.parentCategoryTree} />` (**the PLP breadcrumb**)

The override is not a faithful port. Divergences that now apply to the PLP:

| Base | Override | Impact |
|---|---|---|
| `({categories, ...rest})`, `...rest` spread onto the root | `{categories, currentPage}`, no rest spread (`index.tsx:47`) | pass-through props silently dropped |
| `categories: PropTypes.array` (optional) | `categories: readonly …[]` **required** (`index.tsx:14`) | narrower contract than base |
| `className="sf-breadcrumb"`, `data-testid="sf-crumb-item"` | neither | any selector keyed on these breaks (none in-repo today) |
| `useStyleConfig('Breadcrumb')` — theme-driven | styles hardcoded in the component (`index.tsx:22-35`) | breaks the branch's own theme-recipe pattern |
| `<ChevronRightIcon>` separator | literal `/` text (`index.tsx:39`) | **PLP breadcrumb visual changes**, unreviewed by design |
| Chakra `Breadcrumb`/`BreadcrumbItem`/`BreadcrumbLink` | raw `Box`/`Text` | loses Chakra's breadcrumb a11y primitives |
| imports `categoryUrlBuilder` from `app/utils/url` | reimplements it inline (`index.tsx:10-11`) | DRY (`conventions.md`); silently diverges if base changes |

*Checked and NOT a finding:* base `categoryUrlBuilder` ignores its locale argument (`node_modules/.../app/utils/url.js:90`), so the inline copy is behaviourally identical — **no locale-prefix regression**. Base also uses raw `RouteLink`, so no `Link`-component regression either.

CodeRabbit flagged the related import issue at `breadcrumb/index.tsx:4` (Major, still open): the file imports `Box, Text` from `@chakra-ui/react` while the rest of the codebase (`zimmPageToolbar/index.tsx:3`, `product-detail/index.tsx:5`) uses `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/shared/ui`. Inconsistent, and per the `shared/ui` barrel behaviour this bypasses the project's own UI surface.

### 4.5 🟠 Styling-layer boundary — `var(--zimm-*)` in component JSX

`.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` — the hierarchy is `textStyle` → semantic token strings → **theme recipe** → `sx` → `.scss`. `var(--zimm-*)` belongs in `theme/components/*.ts`, not JSX. The author applied this correctly to `PdpProductInfo` (commit `3e1686b`) and then stopped.

Remaining instances:

| File:line | Code |
|---|---|
| `overrides/app/components/breadcrumb/index.tsx:33` | `transition: 'opacity var(--zimm-motion-duration-fast) var(--zimm-motion-easing-standard)'` |
| `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmPageToolbar/index.tsx:58` | `transition: 'color var(--zimm-motion-duration-fast) …, opacity …'` |
| `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:52` | `columnGap={{base: 0, md: 'var(--zimm-scale-4500)'}}` |
| `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:61` | `pl={{base: 'var(--zimm-scale-800)', md: 0}}` |
| `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:62` | `pr={{base: 'var(--zimm-scale-800)', md: 'var(--zimm-scale-3500)'}}` |
| `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:63` | `pt={{base: 'var(--zimm-scale-400)', md: 0}}` |
| `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:69-71` | `Skeleton height="var(--zimm-scale-800)"` / `-500` / `-5xl` |
| `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.stories.tsx:48,54-56,84-86` | same values, duplicated |

**All 15 distinct vars used are verified to exist** in `overrides/app/theme/foundation/zimmTokens.ts` — no dangling-var bug. (`--zimm-scale-5xl` exists at `zimmTokens.ts:147`; `-700`/`-1100`/`-3500`/`-4500` at `:162,165,169,170`.)

## 7. Honest overall assessment

**Verdict: a solid *component* base sitting on an unsafe *integration*. Keep the components, rework the page and the two override-shadow decisions.**

### What is genuinely good — keep it
- **`PdpProductInfo` + its theme recipe is exemplary.** Correct `useMultiStyleConfig` pattern, `Zimm`-prefixed and registered, every escape hatch documented with a written exit path. This is the pattern the rest of the branch should be migrated to.
- **Accessibility was taken seriously and is real, not claimed.** `h1` for the product name, `nav`/`ol`/`li` breadcrumb semantics, `aria-current="page"`, `aria-hidden` separators, and a Storybook `play` that actually asserts tab order (`breadcrumb/index.stories.tsx:46-52`).
- **Storybook coverage is complete and correctly categorised** — all four surfaces, `play` functions only where there's interaction.
- **Gherkin-first E2E workflow followed** — `.feature` before spec, correct `@pdp`/`@SFCC-89` tags on all 10 tests, sensible page-object locators using accessible selectors first.
- **The `generateRegistry.mjs` consumer-count fix is a real, well-reasoned improvement** (specifier anchoring instead of substring grep, plus a single file-walk instead of N subprocesses). It happens to be unrelated to SFCC-89.
- **`tsc` and Vitest are green.**

### What makes it not mergeable as-is
1. **A Tier 1 file was changed after the PR body itself said it was blocked pending approval.** That is the single most serious thing here — not because dompurify is wrong (it's the right call for `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`), but because the process gate was identified and then walked through. It also drags in 16 MB / jsdom on the SSR path with no bundle-budget verification.
2. **Merging this removes add-to-bag and all SEO metadata from the PDP.** Whether that's in scope for "static product information" is a product question no one has answered in the PR. It cannot merge to `develop` without an explicit answer.
3. **The `Breadcrumb` override silently restyles the PLP.** It shadows a shared SFCC component and is not a faithful port — the PLP breadcrumb loses its chevron separators and its theme config. Nobody asked for that and the PR body doesn't mention the PLP at all.
4. **The `Pages/PDP` story is a copy-paste of the page**, so the one artefact reviewers will actually look at is not the thing being reviewed.

### Effort to make it good
Roughly a day of focused work, and it is mostly *decisions*, not code:

- **10 minutes:** `npm run lint:fix` (all 5 errors auto-fixable); delete the redundant `.gitkeep` and the dead `: null`.
- **Half a day:** move `Breadcrumb` and `ZimmPageToolbar` styling into `theme/components/*.ts` recipes (the author already knows how — `3e1686b` is the template); `react-intl` the four hardcoded strings; make `ZimmPageToolbar`'s padding responsive; add the missing per-site SKUs or a hard configuration error.
- **Half a day:** extract a presentational `PdpLayout` so the page and the story stop duplicating; add a Vitest for the breadcrumb-assembly/degradation logic; move `index.test.ts` → `utils/productData.test.ts`.
- **Blocking, needs humans not code:** Integration sign-off on `isomorphic-dompurify` (or swap for a lighter sanitizer); a product/Squad-A decision on the base-PDP replacement scope; UI Designer notification for the two Tier 2 theme files; a squad-lead call on the PDP ownership move.

### Takeover recommendation
Do **not** rebase-and-continue on top of this. Land the four blocking decisions first — dependency approval, PDP replacement scope, breadcrumb-shadow strategy, theme-file owner sign-off — because two of them (scope, breadcrumb) may delete or restructure a meaningful slice of the code. The component layer (`PdpProductInfo`, `ZimmPageToolbar`, the stories, the `.feature`) is worth carrying forward almost verbatim.

207	**Chakra scale caveat (matters for any new recipe):** `theme/index.ts:51-58` registers only
208	`borderWidths, breakpoints, colors, fonts, space, textStyles, components`. `fontSizes`, `sizes`, and
209	`transition` are **deliberately not registered** because Zimmermann and Chakra use the same key names
210	for different values (`theme/index.ts:26-49`). So `fontSize="2xs"` in a recipe silently resolves to
211	Chakra's 10px, not Zimmermann's 14px — which is exactly why `pdpProductInfo.ts` uses
212	`fontSize: 'var(--zimm-font-size-2xs)'`. `spacing` **is** registered as `space`, so `marginBottom: 'l'`

251	## 4. Intercept traps — which apply
252	
253	### (a) base-path import → unstyled base component in Storybook & Vitest
254	
255	**Mechanism confirmed [V]:**
256	- `package.json` `ccExtensibility: {extends: '@salesforce/retail-react-app', overridesDir: 'overrides'}`
257	  — read by the pwa-kit webpack plugin, i.e. **real builds only**.
258	- `.storybook/main.js:25` aliases `'@salesforce/retail-react-app'` → `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app`,
259	  bypassing the resolver entirely.
260	- `vitest.config.ts:17-20` aliases only `~` and `app` — it never mentions
261	  `@salesforce/retail-react-app`, so those imports go straight to `node_modules` by normal resolution.
262	
263	**Does it apply to the PDP work today? Not yet.** I cross-referenced every base-path import in
264	`overrides/` against every existing override directory. The **only** collision in the entire repo is
265	`icons`, and it is deliberate (`overrides/app/components/icons/index.tsx:73` re-exports from the base
266	icon set — that's the documented single-source-of-truth pattern; `header/index.tsx:44` imports the
267	same base path). **[V]**
268	
269	Every other base-path import in `overrides/` resolves to a module we do **not** override
270	(`shared/ui`, `constants`, `contexts`, `utils/*`, `seo`, `link`, `loading-spinner`, `search`,
271	`with-registration`, `product-scroller`, `section`, `hooks/use-multi-site`, `hooks/use-current-basket`,
272	`hooks/use-navigation`, `hooks/use-einstein`, `app/theme`, `app/routes`, `app/mocks/standard-product`).
273	Per `overrideStyling.md` that is simply correct. **[V]**
274	
275	**It becomes live the moment PDP work adds an override.** Concretely: if you create
276	`overrides/app/components/swatch-group/`, then `product-view/index.jsx:55` imports it by base path —
277	correct in the app, base-unstyled in Storybook/Vitest. Same for `image-gallery` (`product-view:44,48`),
278	`display-price` (`product-view:53` + 5 others), `quantity-picker` (`product-view:50`),
279	`breadcrumb` (**already overridden**, and `product-view/index.jsx:45` imports it by base path — so the
280	moment anything writes a story or test that renders base `ProductView`, it will render the *base*
281	breadcrumb, not ours). **[V]**
282	
283	Rule for new PDP code, per `overrideStyling.md` > "Importing an already-overridden component":
284	import an already-overridden sibling by **relative path** (`'../breadcrumb'`), never by base path. The
285	PDP page already does this correctly at `index.tsx:6,8,9` (all relative `../../components/…`). **[V]**
286	
287	### (b) `shared/ui` barrel — a relative re-export the resolver never rewrites
288	
289	**Confirmed with hard numbers [V]:**
290	- `node_modules/…/app/components/shared/ui/index.jsx` is a pure barrel of **103** relative re-exports
291	  (`export {Box} from './Box'`, `export {Button} from './Button'`, …).
292	- Base files importing the barrel path `…/components/shared/ui'`: **212**.
293	- Base files importing a deep `…/components/shared/ui/<Name>` path: **0**.
294	
295	Because the re-export is relative (`'./Button'`), the `ccExtensibility` resolver — which only rewrites
296	`@salesforce/retail-react-app/...` specifiers — never sees it. Creating
297	`overrides/app/components/shared/ui/Button/index.tsx` would intercept **zero** of those 212 consumers.
298	You would additionally have to override the barrel itself.
299	
300	**Does the PDP work depend on this? No, and it should not start.** The sub-modules are one-line Chakra
301	re-exports (`shared/ui/Skeleton/index.jsx` is literally `export {Skeleton} from '@chakra-ui/react'`) —
302	there is nothing to override there. No `overrides/app/components/shared/` exists on HEAD or `develop`
303	(`git ls-tree` = 0 on both). The correct lever for `Box`/`Text`/`Skeleton` styling is the Chakra theme,
304	which is already how the repo does it. **[V]**
305	
306	Style consistency note: `breadcrumb/index.tsx:3` imports `Box, Text` from `@chakra-ui/react` directly
307	while `product-detail/index.tsx:5` and `zimmPageToolbar/index.tsx:3` import them from the SFCC
308	`shared/ui` barrel. Functionally identical (the barrel is a Chakra re-export), but pick one for new
309	files. **[V]**

334	## 5. Data layer
335	
336	**Rule** (`.claude/rules/components.md` > Composition): anything under `overrides/app/components/`
337	receives data as props and calls **no** data-fetching hook — not `useProduct`, not any
338	`@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react` / React Query hook. Fetching lives in `overrides/app/pages/`. **[V]**
339	
340	**The PDP obeys this today** — `useProduct`/`useCategory` are called only in
341	`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:21-31`; `PdpProductInfo`, `Breadcrumb` and
342	`ZimmPageToolbar` are all pure prop-driven. **[V]**
343	
344	**Type chain [V]:**
345	
346	```
347	useProduct  →  node_modules/@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react/hooks/ShopperProducts/query.d.ts:28
348	               UseQueryResult<DataType<Client['getProduct']>>
349	            →  commerce-sdk-isomorphic ShopperProductsModelTypes.Product
350	               (node_modules/commerce-sdk-isomorphic/lib/index.esm.d.ts:59783-59835)
351	```
352	
353	Fields the PDP already reads, all optional on the type: `id: string` (the only required one), `name?`,
354	`price?`, `currency?`, `shortDescription?`, `longDescription?`, `primaryCategoryId?`. Also available and
355	unused: `imageGroups?: Array<ImageGroup>`, `variants?`, `variationAttributes?`, `variationValues?`,
356	`master?`, `inventory?`/`inventories?`, `type?: ProductType`, `setProducts?`, `bundledProducts?`,
357	`productPromotions?`, `priceRanges?`, `prices?`, `pageMetaTags?`, `slugUrl?`. **[V]**
358	
359	**Custom SFCC attributes.** The type ends in `& { [key: string]: any }` (`index.esm.d.ts:59834`), so any
360	`c_*` attribute typechecks as `any` for free. The repo deliberately does **not** rely on that — it
361	declares a narrowed intersection type instead:
362	
363	```ts
364	// overrides/app/types/commerce.ts:7-10
365	export type ProductWithSizeFit = NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof useProduct>['data']> & {
366	  c_sizeFit?: string;
367	};
368	```
369	
370	Used at `product-detail/index.tsx:78` as `(product as ProductWithSizeFit | undefined)?.c_sizeFit`.
371	**Copy this pattern for every new `c_*` attribute** — add the field to `commerce.ts`, re-export from
372	`types/index.ts`. It satisfies AGENTS.md > Type Definitions ("don't re-declare types already exported by
373	`commerce-sdk-isomorphic`") by deriving from `ReturnType<typeof useProduct>` rather than restating it. **[V]**
374	
375	**Category shape:** `useCategory(...).data.parentCategoryTree` → `Array<PathRecord>` where
376	`PathRecord = {id?: string; name?: string}` (`index.esm.d.ts:~59860`). The PDP narrows it to a local
377	`BreadcrumbCategory {id: string; name: string}` with a type predicate at `index.tsx:38-40`. **[V]**
378	
379	**Mocking policy.** AGENTS.md > Rules: no MSW / hardcoded fixtures in **production paths**. Stories and
380	tests are not production paths — `index.stories.tsx:4` imports
381	`mockStandardProductOrderable` from `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/mocks/standard-product` and that is
382	compliant. **[V]**

399	  on `:6006` via `http-server`, then `node_modules/.bin/test-storybook --ci --url http://127.0.0.1:6006`.
400	  Note it invokes the binary directly — **there is no `test-storybook` npm script** in `package.json`,
401	  so locally you must run `node_modules/.bin/test-storybook` yourself. **[V]**
402	
403	### 6b. What `qa.yml` gates (PRs to `develop` and `release/**` only)
404	
405	| Job | Gated? | Condition |
406	|---|---|---|
407	| `unit-tests` (Vitest, `npm test`) | **Yes** | `qa.yml:207-227`; runs if any `overrides/**`, `vitest.config.*`, `vitest.setup.ts`, `tsconfig.json`, `babel.config.js` changed, or `package.json` `dependencies` changed |
408	| `storybook-test` (play + a11y) | **Yes** | `qa.yml:236-272`; runs if `overrides/app/{components,pages,hooks,theme,types}/**`, `.storybook/**`, or `package*.json` changed |
409	| `e2e-localhost` (Playwright, real SFCC dev org) | **Yes** | `qa.yml:280-409` |
410	| `e2e-browserstack` | Conditional | `qa.yml:427-473`; `release/**` → full suite; `develop` PR → only if an `SFCC-\d+` key appears in PR title/body/branch, `--grep`-scoped to it |
411	| **ESLint** | **NO** | `grep -rnE 'eslint\|npm run lint' .github/workflows/` → **zero matches across all 15 workflow files** **[V]** |
412	| **Prettier / `npm run format`** | **NO** | same grep, zero matches. Only local: `.claude/settings.json` PostToolUse `Write` runs `prettier --write` on newly-written files **[V]** |
413	| **`tsc --noEmit`** | **NO** | same grep, zero matches. It is an AGENTS.md hard requirement enforced by nobody but you **[V]** |
414	
415	Git hooks in `.husky/` are `commit-msg` (conventional commits), `pre-commit` (registry regen + Contentful
416	drift + derived-AI-config protection + `.env.sample` secret guard), `pre-push` (tag-name validation).
417	**None of the three runs lint, prettier, or tsc.** **[V]**
418	
419	### 6c. E2E scoping — a PDP change runs the FULL suite
420	
421	`qa.yml:97-102` defines exactly one area allow-list, `e2e_homepage`. There is **no `e2e_pdp` group**,
422	even though 11 specs already carry `@pdp`. `qa.yml:135-146` narrows to an area only when *every*
423	e2e-relevant changed file falls inside that one area's list — a PDP file never does, so `e2e_scope`
424	falls back to `full`. That is the deliberate fail-safe direction (more tests, not fewer), not a bug —
425	but it means every PDP PR pays for the whole Playwright suite. Adding an `e2e_pdp` group is a cheap,
426	self-contained follow-up. **[V]**
427	
428	### 6d. What a new PDP component is actually required to have
429	
430	Per `.claude/rules/testing.md` and `.claude/rules/components.md` > Storybook **[V]**:
431	
432	| Layer | Required? |
433	|---|---|
434	| `*.stories.tsx` | **Yes, always**, for anything exported from its folder under `components/` or `pages/`. Not required for a sub-component that only ever renders inside one parent. Needs a `Default` export; named exports for meaningful states only. |
435	| `play` fn inside the story | Only when there is interactive behaviour worth asserting (validation on blur, disclosure open/close, focus movement, controlled-input wiring). Purely visual stories need none. Query via `within(canvasElement)`, `getByRole` first. Import `userEvent`/`expect` from the Storybook re-export — `pdpProductInfo/index.stories.tsx:2` uses `from 'storybook/test'`. |
436	| `*.test.ts` (Vitest) | Only when failure would be non-obvious or costly: data mapping, integration boundaries, complex state, pure logic that survives a refactor invisibly. Explicitly **not** for re-exports, one-liners, or framework behaviour. `extractModelLine` is the canonical example of a "yes". |
437	| `.feature` + Playwright spec | For a new user journey. Gherkin first, **Lead QA signs off the `.feature` before any Playwright is written** (`.claude/skills/qa-generate/`). Tag every `test()` with both `@<area>` and `@SFCC-NNN`. |
438	
439	Storybook category for PDP components: **`Commerce/`** (`components.md` > Categorisation — "Commerce-specific
440	shared components"). `Pages/` for the full page assembly. Titles in use today are all consistent with
441	the rules table **[V]**: `Commerce/PdpProductInfo`, `Pages/PDP`, `Layout/Breadcrumb`,
442	`Layout/PageToolbar`, `Elements/Button`. Note `zimmPageToolbar`'s story title is `Layout/PageToolbar`
443	(no `Zimm` prefix) while the component and folder are `ZimmPageToolbar`/`zimmPageToolbar` — follow the
444	same shape for new ui-kit components.
445	
446	Accessibility rules are **mechanically enforced** by `.coderabbit/ast-grep-rules/` at PR review:
447	`<img>` needs `alt`, `IconButton` needs `aria-label`, non-interactive element with `onClick` needs
448	`role` (+ `tabIndex={0}` + `onKeyDown`). `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` must wrap its value in a sanitizer —
449	enforced by `semgrep.yml`. `pdpProductInfo/index.tsx:43,54` already does this with
450	`DOMPurify.sanitize(...)` from `isomorphic-dompurify`. **[V]**
451	
452	---
453	
454	## 7. REUSE OPPORTUNITIES
455	
456	Things a PDP build should be using rather than rebuilding:
457	
458	1. **`PdpProductInfo` + its theme recipe** — `overrides/app/components/pdpProductInfo/index.tsx` and
459	   `overrides/app/theme/components/pdpProductInfo.ts`. Name / price / sanitized description / model
460	   line / style code, all test-id'd, all styled through `useMultiStyleConfig`. **This is the reference
461	   implementation of the repo's styling convention** — copy its structure for every new PDP component.
462	2. **`Breadcrumb`** — `overrides/app/components/breadcrumb/index.tsx`. Wired to live `useCategory`
463	   data, `aria-label="Breadcrumb"`, `aria-current="page"` on the terminal crumb, `aria-hidden`
464	   separators, exports its own `BreadcrumbCategory` type. Import it **relatively**.
465	3. **`ZimmPageToolbar`** — `ui-kits/atoms/zimmPageToolbar/index.tsx`. Already has `recently-viewed`
466	   and `section-title` variants built and **unused**. A "You May Also Like" / "Recently Viewed" PDP
467	   section should use `variant="recently-viewed"` rather than a new wrapper.
468	4. **`extractModelLine`** — `overrides/app/utils/productData.ts`, plus its 5 passing tests.
469	5. **`ProductWithSizeFit`** — `overrides/app/types/commerce.ts`. Extend this file for new `c_*` fields;
470	   don't re-derive the Product type per component.
471	6. **`PDP_OPTIONS_COLUMN_WIDTH`** — exported from `product-detail/index.tsx:14` and already consumed by
472	   the story. Any gallery/options layout work should import it, not restate `360px`.
473	7. **`ProductPage` POM** — `e2e/support/pages/ProductPage.js`. Already has `goToProduct()` with the 20s
474	   SFCC-API gate, `selectVariant()`, `addToCart()`, `getFirstBreadcrumbCategoryLink()`, and locators for
475	   `product-price` / `product-description` / `product-style-code` / `product-model-info` /
476	   `sale-price` / `original-price` / `out-of-stock` / `cart-drawer`. **`sale-price`, `original-price`,
477	   `out-of-stock` and `cart-drawer` locators exist but nothing renders those test-ids yet** — they are a
478	   pre-agreed contract for the next PDP slice. Use those exact test-ids.
479	8. **SFCC-91's `pdpColourSwatches`** — 189 lines of component + 256 lines of Vitest + 204 lines of
480	   stories + an 883-line spec at `.docs/specs/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches.md`, plus the multi-colour
481	   SKU fixture in `e2e/fixtures/products.js`. **Rebase-and-adopt, do not rewrite.** Two caveats: it
482	   predates the `pdpProductInfo` theme-recipe refactor (rebase conflict guaranteed in
483	   `pdpProductInfo/index.tsx`), and it needs relocating to `ui-kits/` + a theme recipe to match convention.
484	9. **`.claude/rules/overrides.md`** on `origin/feature/f2r-component-registry` — the pre-flight checklist
485	   (default export, internal-consumer grep, `forwardRef`, Chakra deep-merge audit, prop-superset pattern,
486	   `vendor.d.ts` ambient rule). If PDP work overrides any SFCC component, run that checklist. Consider
487	   asking for it to be merged to `develop`, since `overrideStyling.md` already links to it and the link
488	   is currently dead.
489	10. **`overrides/app/utils/sfccImage.ts` — `proxyImageUrl(url)`.** **This one matters a lot for the
490	    gallery.** It rewrites an absolute SFCC static-asset URL to `/mobify/proxy/<path>…` by matching the
491	    hostname against `getConfig().ssrParameters.proxyConfigs`. Its JSDoc states the reason: direct
492	    browser access to the Demandware host "is typically blocked by Cloudflare WAF outside of the
493	    Commerce Cloud network." Any code that renders `product.imageGroups[].images[].link` **must** pass
494	    it through this helper or images will 403 for real shoppers. It fails open (returns the URL
495	    unchanged) on a relative or malformed URL. **[V]**
496	
497	### Gaps the takeover should decide about explicitly
498	
499	- **The gallery column is a coloured empty box** (`index.tsx:56`). Everything image-related is unbuilt.
500	- **`overrideStyling.md` vs `uikit-components.md`** — two mutually exclusive styling models on two
501	  branches (§2c). Get a ruling before writing components.
502	- **`ui-kits/` has one component and no rules doc on `develop`** (§2b/2c). Both `pdpProductInfo` and
503	  SFCC-91's `pdpColourSwatches` sit outside it. Either relocate them or stop calling ui-kits settled.
504	- **The story duplicates the page shell** (`index.stories.tsx:43-65` vs `index.tsx:48-88`) because
505	  Storybook has no `CommerceApiProvider`. Adding one to `.storybook/preview.tsx` would delete the
506	  duplication — but `.storybook/` is **Tier 1 frozen** (`frozenFiles.md` > Test & Tooling Config), so
507	  that needs Integration/SI Partner approval.
508	- **Error handling diverges from base**: base throws `HTTPNotFound`/`HTTPError` (`index.jsx:194-209`),
509	  ours renders an inline message (`index.tsx:66`). SEO consequence — a bad `productId` returns HTTP 200
510	  with an error string instead of a 404. AGENTS.md calls SEO a top requirement; worth raising.
511	- **`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/` is Squad A territory** (`.claude/rules/squadA.md:5`, draft),
512	  and the shared product components (`product-tile/`, `display-price/`, `image-gallery/`,
513	  `swatch-group/`, `recommended-products/`, `product-item/`) are **Tier 2, owned by Squad B**
514	  (`protectedFiles.md` > Shared Product Components). Overriding any of them crosses a squad boundary
515	  and needs Squad B notification; AGENTS.md Hard Rule #10 also requires stopping to confirm scope
516	  before touching more than one protection tier in a change.

# PDP integration surface — codebase map

Branch surveyed: `feature/SFCC-89_pdp-ui-static-product-information` @ `d526ad1`, clean tree,
24 commits ahead of `develop` (`cd68e97`). `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0 on this branch (verified).

Legend: **[V]** verified by reading the file/running the command · **[I]** inferred.

---

## 1. PDP surface that already exists

### 1a. The page

`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` — 95 lines. **It is a full replacement of the base
page, not a decoration of it.** It renders only: a grey placeholder box where the gallery goes, a
`PdpProductInfo` block, and a breadcrumb toolbar underneath. **[V]**

| Line | What |
|---|---|
| `index.tsx:14` | `export const PDP_OPTIONS_COLUMN_WIDTH = '360px'` — provisional, commented as pending designer sign-off |
| `index.tsx:21-25` | `useProduct({parameters:{id: productId}}, {enabled: Boolean(productId)})` |
| `index.tsx:28-31` | `useCategory({parameters:{id: product?.primaryCategoryId ?? null, levels:1}})`, gated on the product having loaded |
| `index.tsx:35-40` | Builds breadcrumb path from `category.parentCategoryTree`, degrades to `[]` on category error |
| `index.tsx:42-45` | `intl.formatNumber(product.price, {style:'currency', currency: product.currency})` |
| `index.tsx:56` | **Gallery column is an empty `<Box>` placeholder** — `aspectRatio={{base:'3/4', md:'49/60'}}`, `backgroundColor="background.02"`. Comment: "images out of scope, placeholder maintains layout" |
| `index.tsx:65-81` | error / isLoading / loaded three-way branch |
| `index.tsx:85-87` | `<ZimmPageToolbar variant="breadcrumbs"><Breadcrumb …/></ZimmPageToolbar>` |
| `index.tsx:92` | `ProductDetail.getTemplateName = () => 'product-detail'` |

Route wiring: `overrides/app/routes.tsx:25` (`loadable(() => import('./pages/product-detail'))`)
and `:38-40` place `/product/:productId` **before** `..._routes` (`:41`), so the override wins by
route order regardless of the module resolver. **[V]**

### 1b. What the base has that we have *not* carried over

Base is `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/product-detail/index.jsx` — 876 lines
vs our 95. Everything below is present in base and **absent** from the override **[V]**:

| Base capability | Base ref | Status in override |
|---|---|---|
| `ProductView` (gallery, swatches, qty, add-to-bag) | `index.jsx:41, 675/707/789` | absent |
| `RecommendedProducts` ×3 zones (Einstein) | `index.jsx:40, 817/832/847` | absent |
| `InformationAccordion` (`partials/information-accordion.jsx`) | `index.jsx:42, 776/808` | absent |
| `<Island hydrateOn='visible'>` deferred hydration wrappers | `index.jsx:674, 788, 816…` | absent |
| `<Helmet>` SEO block | `index.jsx:658-669` | absent |
| `HTTPNotFound` / `HTTPError` throw on 404/5xx | `index.jsx:194-209` | **absent — we render an inline `<Text>` instead (`index.tsx:66`)** |
| `res.set('Cache-Control', …)` SSR cache headers | `index.jsx:86-87` | absent |
| Rich `useProduct` params: `perPricebook`, `allImages`, `expand:[availability, promotions, options, images, prices, variations, set_products, bundled_products, page_meta_tags]`, `inventoryIds`, `keepPreviousData` | `index.jsx:110-136` | **absent — our call requests `id` only** |
| Set / bundle branch (`isProductASet`, `isProductABundle`) | `index.jsx:155-156, 672` | absent |
| `useProductInventory`, `useVariant`, `useCurrentBasket`, wishlist, toast, Einstein/DataCloud/ActiveData | `index.jsx:70-240` | absent |

> Note on `allImages: true` — memory file `project_sfcc29_product_display_outage.md` records this
> flag as implicated in a backend product-display outage. Re-check before adding it back.

### 1c. PDP-adjacent components — override + recipe status

`ls overrides/app/components/` on this branch: `_app-config breadcrumb button contentful foundation
header icons pageContainer pdpProductInfo ui-kits` — **that is the whole list.** **[V]**

| Component | Override exists? | Theme recipe in `theme/components/`? | Base consumers if you override it later |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image-gallery` | **No** (also not on `develop` — `git ls-tree` = 0) | No | 2: `product-view`, `product-view-modal/bundle` |
| `swatch-group` | **No** | No | 2: `product-tile`, `product-view` |
| `display-price` | **No** | No | **6**: `product-tile`, `item-variant/item-price`, `product-view`, `use-add-to-cart-modal`, 2× checkout cards |
| `product-tile` | **No** | No | 2: `product-scroller`, `pages/product-list` |
| `product-item` | **No** | No | 3 |
| `recommended-products` | **No** | No | 5 |
| `product-view` | **No** | No | **6** incl. `product-view-modal`, `bonus-product-view-modal` |
| `quantity-picker` | **No** | No | 2: `product-view`, `product-item/product-quantity-picker` |
| `breadcrumb` | **Yes** — `overrides/app/components/breadcrumb/index.tsx` (86 ln) | No (styles inline in the file) | 1 base consumer: `product-view/index.jsx:45` |
| `pdpProductInfo` (Zimmermann-only) | **Yes** — 69 ln | **Yes** — `theme/components/pdpProductInfo.ts`, registered `theme/components/index.ts:4,10` as `ZimmPdpProductInfo` | n/a |
| `zimmPageToolbar` (Zimmermann-only) | **Yes** — `ui-kits/atoms/zimmPageToolbar/index.tsx` (73 ln) | **No** — styling is a `PADDING` const at `index.tsx:28-33` | n/a |

**Important correction to a common assumption:** `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` talks at length
about `product-tile/index.tsx`'s `DisplayPrice` import, `image-gallery`/`display-price`/`swatch-group`
theme configs, and `swatchGroup.ts`/`imageGallery.ts` recipe files. **None of those files exist on
this branch or on `develop`.** The rules doc describes an intended/aspirational state, or state from
a branch that never merged. Do not plan work assuming those overrides are there. **[V]**

Theme recipes that actually exist: `button.ts`, `header.ts`, `listMenu.ts`, `navConstants.ts`,
`pdpProductInfo.ts`, `index.ts`. **[V]**

### 1d. Supporting assets already built for PDP

- `overrides/app/utils/productData.ts` — `extractModelLine(html)`: pulls the `Model is …` `<li>` out
  of the SFCC `c_sizeFit` HTML. 9 lines, 5 unit tests. **[V]**
- `overrides/app/types/commerce.ts:7-10` — `ProductWithSizeFit`, re-exported from
  `overrides/app/types/index.ts:1`. **[V]**
- `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.test.ts` — 5 Vitest cases, all on `extractModelLine`. **[V]**
- `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.stories.tsx` — `title: 'Pages/PDP'`, 3 stories
  (`Default`/`Loading`/`Error`). Re-implements the page shell (`PageShell`, `:43-65`) rather than
  rendering `ProductDetail`, because `useProduct` needs a `CommerceApiProvider` Storybook doesn't have
  (`:12-15`). **This shell is a duplicate of `index.tsx:48-88` and will drift.** **[V]**
- `overrides/app/components/pdpProductInfo/index.stories.tsx` — `title: 'Commerce/PdpProductInfo'`,
  2 stories, one with a `play` fn. **[V]**
- E2E: `e2e/features/pdp/SFCC-89_pdp-static-product-information.feature`,
  `e2e/tests/zimm/pdp/SFCC-89_pdp-static-product-information.spec.js` (10 tests, all tagged
  `{tag: ['@pdp','@SFCC-89']}`, 3 currently `test.skip`), and a `ProductPage` POM at
  `e2e/support/pages/ProductPage.js` with locators already wired to our test-ids. **[V]**

### 1e. The other in-flight PDP branch — read this before starting

`origin/feature/SFCC-91_pdp-ui-colour-swatches-variation-selection` (2026-08-21, `3b531d4`) **branches
off SFCC-89 at `d904c63`** and adds **[V]**:

- `overrides/app/components/pdpColourSwatches/{index.tsx,index.stories.tsx,index.test.tsx}` (189/204/256 ln)
- `.docs/specs/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches.md` (883 lines)
- `e2e/features/pdp/SFCC-91_*.feature` + `e2e/tests/zimm/pdp/SFCC-91_*.spec.js`
- extensions to `e2e/fixtures/products.js` and `ProductPage.js`

It is **missing SFCC-89's last two commits** (`3e1686b` "move PdpProductInfo styling into a theme
config", `d526ad1`) — so on SFCC-91, `pdpProductInfo/index.tsx` is still 98 lines with inline styling
and `theme/components/pdpProductInfo.ts` does not exist. **A rebase of SFCC-91 onto SFCC-89 head will
conflict in `pdpProductInfo/index.tsx`.** **[V]**

Also: `pdpColourSwatches` is at the **top level of `components/`, not under `ui-kits/`, and has no
theme recipe** — same divergence as `pdpProductInfo`. **[V]**

---

## 2. What a new PDP component must look like structurally

### 2a. The naming families — keep them straight

| Family | Case | Where | Live examples on this branch |
|---|---|---|---|
| SFCC override dirs (shadow a base module) | **kebab-case**, matching the base filename exactly | `overrides/app/components/<kebab>/` | `breadcrumb/`, `header/`, `icons/`, `_app-config/` |
| Zimmermann-authored components | **camelCase** | `overrides/app/components/<camel>/` or `ui-kits/<tier>/<camel>/` | `pdpProductInfo/`, `pageContainer/`, `button/`, `ui-kits/atoms/zimmPageToolbar/` |
| SFCC `shared/ui` primitives | **PascalCase** | `node_modules/…/app/components/shared/ui/<Pascal>/` | `Box/`, `Text/`, `Skeleton/` — thin re-exports of Chakra |

Rule source: `.claude/rules/conventions.md` > File naming and folder structure. **[V]**

### 2b. What `ui-kits/` actually contains today

```
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/
└── atoms/
    ├── .gitkeep
    └── zimmPageToolbar/
        ├── index.tsx
        └── index.stories.tsx
```

**One component. No `molecules/`, no `organisms/` directories exist.** **[V]**

### 2c. Where the `ui-kits/{atoms,molecules,organisms}` convention is written down — and the problem

Grepping the whole repo for `ui-kits` on this branch returns **three hits**: two imports in the PDP
page/story, and one row in the generated registry. **There is no rules doc on this branch or on
`develop` that states the ui-kits convention.** **[V]**

The doc exists only on an unmerged branch: `.claude/rules/uikit-components.md`, 512 lines, on
`origin/feature/f2r-implementation-workflow` (last commit 2026-08-11). **[V]**

**That doc contradicts the styling rules on `develop`.** Read side by side **[V]**:

| `.claude/rules/uikit-components.md` (f2r-implementation-workflow, unmerged) | `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` (on `develop` since `5b36062`, 2026-08-18) |
|---|---|
| "`import { Box, Flex, Text, … } from '@chakra-ui/react'` is **forbidden** inside `ui-kits/{tier}/{component}/`" | Hierarchy level 1–3 is Chakra `textStyle` props, semantic token strings, then a `theme/components/<name>.ts` config |
| Co-located `{component}.styles.ts` + Emotion `<Global styles={…}/>` per component; "There is no fallback." | "`.zimm-*` classes remain the right tool for genuinely static, non-interactive… treatments"; a class mirror of an interactive component is "structurally incomplete from the start" |
| Handover CSS class names via `className`, inline `style={{color:'var(--zimm-color-…)'}}` | "**Never**: a raw hex/px/rem/em literal in a component file"; theme config is "the single source of truth" |

`f2r-implementation-workflow` does **not** contain `overrideStyling.md` at all — the two rule sets are
mutually exclusive, living on different branches. The newer `origin/feature/f2r-component-registry`
(2026-08-21, 27 commits ahead, `develop` **is** its ancestor) carries `overrideStyling.md` **and** adds
`.claude/rules/overrides.md`, but **not** `uikit-components.md`. **[V]**

**[I]** Reading recency: `overrideStyling.md` (Aug 18, on develop) supersedes `uikit-components.md`
(Aug 11, unmerged), and the surviving f2r branch dropped the latter. Treat `overrideStyling.md` as
authoritative. **This is a judgement call that should be confirmed with the developer** before a
takeover commits to one styling model.

### 2d. Missing cross-referenced doc

`.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` cross-references `[overrides.md](./overrides.md)` in at least five
places. **`.claude/rules/overrides.md` does not exist on this branch or on `develop`** — it exists only
on `origin/feature/f2r-component-registry`. **[V]** Its content (verified by `git show`): the
replacement-not-wrapping rule, four pre-flight checks (default export present, `grep` for internal SFCC
usage, `forwardRef` contract, Chakra `defineStyleConfig` deep-merge audit), the prop-superset
default/named-export pattern, and the `vendor.d.ts` ambient-declaration all-or-nothing rule.

### 2e. Concrete path example — a new PDP component per the rules as written

For a hypothetical `PdpSizeSelector`:

```
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/pdpSizeSelector/
  index.tsx            ← named export PdpSizeSelector + default; props type at top of file
  index.stories.tsx    ← title: 'Commerce/PdpSizeSelector'  (commerce-aware → Commerce/, per components.md)
  index.test.ts        ← only if logic-heavy
overrides/app/theme/components/pdpSizeSelector.ts   ← exports `ZimmPdpSizeSelector` (parts + baseStyle)
overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts             ← add import + key to the `components` object
```

Existing precedent to copy verbatim — `pdpProductInfo` **[V]**:
- Component consumes the recipe via `useMultiStyleConfig('ZimmPdpProductInfo', {})` and applies parts
  as `__css={styles.<part>}` (`pdpProductInfo/index.tsx:27, 32`).
- Recipe declares `parts: ['name','price','description','modelInfo','styleCode']` and a `baseStyle`
  per part (`theme/components/pdpProductInfo.ts:56-90`).
- Values that genuinely can't live in `baseStyle` (conditional margins) are exported as named consts
  from the theme file and imported by the component — `SPACE_DESCRIPTION_TO_META`,
  `SPACE_MODEL_INFO_TO_STYLE_CODE` (`pdpProductInfo.ts:47,50` → `index.tsx:4,42,53`). That is the
  house pattern for "styling that must be at the call site": **name it in the theme file anyway.**
- The theme file carries a header comment explaining each level-4 (`var(--zimm-*)`) escape and why
  no `textStyle` exists for it yet (`pdpProductInfo.ts:1-33`).

**Chakra scale caveat (matters for any new recipe):** `theme/index.ts:51-58` registers only
`borderWidths, breakpoints, colors, fonts, space, textStyles, components`. `fontSizes`, `sizes`, and
`transition` are **deliberately not registered** because Zimmermann and Chakra use the same key names
for different values (`theme/index.ts:26-49`). So `fontSize="2xs"` in a recipe silently resolves to
Chakra's 10px, not Zimmermann's 14px — which is exactly why `pdpProductInfo.ts` uses
`fontSize: 'var(--zimm-font-size-2xs)'`. `spacing` **is** registered as `space`, so `marginBottom: 'l'`
is safe. **[V]**

## 3. The component registry

**What it is:** `scripts/generateRegistry.mjs` (37 kB) scans `overrides/app/{components,hooks,utils,pages}`
**plus** `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/`, and writes markdown tables to
`.claude/registry/{components,hooks,pages,routes,utils}.md` so Claude reads a table instead of grepping.
Columns: Component · Origin · Path · Props · Tier · Squad · Consumers · Last touched · Description. **[V]**

**Does a new PDP component register itself? No — it is fully automatic.** Nothing is hand-maintained
**[V]**:
- `generateRegistry.mjs:670` — `origin: baseMatch ? 'Override' : 'Custom'`, matched by folder-name
  variants (`folderVariants()` at `:105-109` tries kebab↔camel), so a camelCase Zimmermann folder with
  no base twin is auto-classified `Custom`.
- Tier and squad are derived from `.claude/rules/` path lists (`generateRegistry.mjs:~112` onward).
- `scripts/hooks/pre-commit:49-62` regenerates and `git add`s `.claude/registry/` whenever a staged path
  matches `overrides/app/{components,hooks,utils,pages}/` or `routes.tsx`.
- `.claude/settings.json` PostToolUse `Edit|Write` → `.claude/hooks/registryUpdate.sh` → incremental
  `--file=` regen (skips `*.test.*`, `*.stories.*`, `ContentfulDefinition`).
- `package.json` `postinstall` runs `npm run generate:registry`.

**Is it a blocker? No.** The registry is **already on `develop`** (`git ls-tree develop` lists all five
`.claude/registry/*.md`, `scripts/generateRegistry.mjs`, and `.claude/hooks/registryUpdate.sh`) and
therefore on this branch. **[V]** `feature/f2r-component-registry` adds one extra output
(`.claude/registry/mocks.md`) and generator refinements, but nothing the PDP work depends on.

The premise in the task brief that the registry might be "not yet merged to develop" is **false** — it
is merged. **[V]**

Minor: `.claude/registry/components.md:84` shows `ZimmPageToolbar`'s props flattened across its
discriminated union (`variant: 'breadcrumbs', heading: string, …`). Commit `cf17c3d` on this branch
("teach extractTsProps to parse discriminated union Props types") fixes the generator; the checked-in
`.md` is stamped `2026-08-20` and predates it. Cosmetic — a regen will correct it. **[V]**

## 4. Intercept traps — which apply

### (a) base-path import → unstyled base component in Storybook & Vitest

**Mechanism confirmed [V]:**
- `package.json` `ccExtensibility: {extends: '@salesforce/retail-react-app', overridesDir: 'overrides'}`
  — read by the pwa-kit webpack plugin, i.e. **real builds only**.
- `.storybook/main.js:25` aliases `'@salesforce/retail-react-app'` → `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app`,
  bypassing the resolver entirely.
- `vitest.config.ts:17-20` aliases only `~` and `app` — it never mentions
  `@salesforce/retail-react-app`, so those imports go straight to `node_modules` by normal resolution.

**Does it apply to the PDP work today? Not yet.** I cross-referenced every base-path import in
`overrides/` against every existing override directory. The **only** collision in the entire repo is
`icons`, and it is deliberate (`overrides/app/components/icons/index.tsx:73` re-exports from the base
icon set — that's the documented single-source-of-truth pattern; `header/index.tsx:44` imports the
same base path). **[V]**

Every other base-path import in `overrides/` resolves to a module we do **not** override
(`shared/ui`, `constants`, `contexts`, `utils/*`, `seo`, `link`, `loading-spinner`, `search`,
`with-registration`, `product-scroller`, `section`, `hooks/use-multi-site`, `hooks/use-current-basket`,
`hooks/use-navigation`, `hooks/use-einstein`, `app/theme`, `app/routes`, `app/mocks/standard-product`).
Per `overrideStyling.md` that is simply correct. **[V]**

**It becomes live the moment PDP work adds an override.** Concretely: if you create
`overrides/app/components/swatch-group/`, then `product-view/index.jsx:55` imports it by base path —
correct in the app, base-unstyled in Storybook/Vitest. Same for `image-gallery` (`product-view:44,48`),
`display-price` (`product-view:53` + 5 others), `quantity-picker` (`product-view:50`),
`breadcrumb` (**already overridden**, and `product-view/index.jsx:45` imports it by base path — so the
moment anything writes a story or test that renders base `ProductView`, it will render the *base*
breadcrumb, not ours). **[V]**

Rule for new PDP code, per `overrideStyling.md` > "Importing an already-overridden component":
import an already-overridden sibling by **relative path** (`'../breadcrumb'`), never by base path. The
PDP page already does this correctly at `index.tsx:6,8,9` (all relative `../../components/…`). **[V]**

### (b) `shared/ui` barrel — a relative re-export the resolver never rewrites

**Confirmed with hard numbers [V]:**
- `node_modules/…/app/components/shared/ui/index.jsx` is a pure barrel of **103** relative re-exports
  (`export {Box} from './Box'`, `export {Button} from './Button'`, …).
- Base files importing the barrel path `…/components/shared/ui'`: **212**.
- Base files importing a deep `…/components/shared/ui/<Name>` path: **0**.

Because the re-export is relative (`'./Button'`), the `ccExtensibility` resolver — which only rewrites
`@salesforce/retail-react-app/...` specifiers — never sees it. Creating
`overrides/app/components/shared/ui/Button/index.tsx` would intercept **zero** of those 212 consumers.
You would additionally have to override the barrel itself.

**Does the PDP work depend on this? No, and it should not start.** The sub-modules are one-line Chakra
re-exports (`shared/ui/Skeleton/index.jsx` is literally `export {Skeleton} from '@chakra-ui/react'`) —
there is nothing to override there. No `overrides/app/components/shared/` exists on HEAD or `develop`
(`git ls-tree` = 0 on both). The correct lever for `Box`/`Text`/`Skeleton` styling is the Chakra theme,
which is already how the repo does it. **[V]**

Style consistency note: `breadcrumb/index.tsx:3` imports `Box, Text` from `@chakra-ui/react` directly
while `product-detail/index.tsx:5` and `zimmPageToolbar/index.tsx:3` import them from the SFCC
`shared/ui` barrel. Functionally identical (the barrel is a Chakra re-export), but pick one for new
files. **[V]**

### (c) conditional render of an alternate module

**The `_app` checkout swap is real but does not touch PDP [V]:**
`node_modules/…/app/components/_app/index.jsx:216` computes `const isCheckout = /\/checkout$/.test(location?.pathname)`,
then `:403` swaps `Header` → `CheckoutHeader` and `:484` `{!isCheckout ? <Footer /> : <CheckoutFooter />}`.
`/product/:productId` never matches that regex, so PDP always gets the normal Header/Footer.
**No PDP equivalent of this trap exists.** **[V]**

**Two adjacent things worth knowing anyway [V]:**
1. **`<Island hydrateOn='visible'>`.** Base wraps `ProductView`, `InformationAccordion`, and all three
   `RecommendedProducts` in `<Island>` (`product-detail/index.jsx:674, 788, 816, 831, 846`) — deferred
   hydration. Our override uses no Island. If PDP work reintroduces base components, they will hydrate
   eagerly unless Island is reintroduced too. Relevant to the ≤2s p75 mobile LCP budget in AGENTS.md.
2. **Set/bundle branch.** `product-detail/index.jsx:672` renders a structurally different tree for
   `isProductASet || isProductABundle` (per-child `ProductView` + `InformationAccordion`). Our override
   renders one shape for every product type, so a set or bundle SKU will render as a plain product. Not
   an override-bypass — a functional gap. **[V]**
3. `ProductView` is rendered from 6 places, not just PDP (`product-view-modal/index.jsx`,
   `product-view-modal/bundle.jsx`, `bonus-product-view-modal/index.jsx`, + tests). An override of it
   is a Tier-2-scale blast radius, not a PDP-local change. **[V]**

---

## 5. Data layer

**Rule** (`.claude/rules/components.md` > Composition): anything under `overrides/app/components/`
receives data as props and calls **no** data-fetching hook — not `useProduct`, not any
`@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react` / React Query hook. Fetching lives in `overrides/app/pages/`. **[V]**

**The PDP obeys this today** — `useProduct`/`useCategory` are called only in
`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx:21-31`; `PdpProductInfo`, `Breadcrumb` and
`ZimmPageToolbar` are all pure prop-driven. **[V]**

**Type chain [V]:**

```
useProduct  →  node_modules/@salesforce/commerce-sdk-react/hooks/ShopperProducts/query.d.ts:28
               UseQueryResult<DataType<Client['getProduct']>>
            →  commerce-sdk-isomorphic ShopperProductsModelTypes.Product
               (node_modules/commerce-sdk-isomorphic/lib/index.esm.d.ts:59783-59835)
```

Fields the PDP already reads, all optional on the type: `id: string` (the only required one), `name?`,
`price?`, `currency?`, `shortDescription?`, `longDescription?`, `primaryCategoryId?`. Also available and
unused: `imageGroups?: Array<ImageGroup>`, `variants?`, `variationAttributes?`, `variationValues?`,
`master?`, `inventory?`/`inventories?`, `type?: ProductType`, `setProducts?`, `bundledProducts?`,
`productPromotions?`, `priceRanges?`, `prices?`, `pageMetaTags?`, `slugUrl?`. **[V]**

**Custom SFCC attributes.** The type ends in `& { [key: string]: any }` (`index.esm.d.ts:59834`), so any
`c_*` attribute typechecks as `any` for free. The repo deliberately does **not** rely on that — it
declares a narrowed intersection type instead:

```ts
// overrides/app/types/commerce.ts:7-10
export type ProductWithSizeFit = NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof useProduct>['data']> & {
  c_sizeFit?: string;
};
```

Used at `product-detail/index.tsx:78` as `(product as ProductWithSizeFit | undefined)?.c_sizeFit`.
**Copy this pattern for every new `c_*` attribute** — add the field to `commerce.ts`, re-export from
`types/index.ts`. It satisfies AGENTS.md > Type Definitions ("don't re-declare types already exported by
`commerce-sdk-isomorphic`") by deriving from `ReturnType<typeof useProduct>` rather than restating it. **[V]**

**Category shape:** `useCategory(...).data.parentCategoryTree` → `Array<PathRecord>` where
`PathRecord = {id?: string; name?: string}` (`index.esm.d.ts:~59860`). The PDP narrows it to a local
`BreadcrumbCategory {id: string; name: string}` with a type predicate at `index.tsx:38-40`. **[V]**

**Mocking policy.** AGENTS.md > Rules: no MSW / hardcoded fixtures in **production paths**. Stories and
tests are not production paths — `index.stories.tsx:4` imports
`mockStandardProductOrderable` from `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/mocks/standard-product` and that is
compliant. **[V]**

---

## 6. Test requirements & what CI actually enforces

### 6a. Storybook a11y — gated. Confirmed still true.

- `.storybook/preview.tsx:34-50` sets `parameters.a11y.test = 'error'`, with an inline comment:
  "'error' causes a11y violations to fail `test-storybook --ci` runs". It also excludes the six Chakra
  toast-manager `role="region"` containers from all a11y checks. **[V]**
- `.storybook/` contains exactly two files: `main.js`, `preview.tsx`. **There is no
  `.storybook/test-runner.js`, and none is needed** — `@storybook/test-runner` v0.24 reads
  `parameters.a11y.test` from `preview.tsx` directly. **[V]**
- `@storybook/test-runner ^0.24.4` and `@storybook/addon-a11y ^10.4.6` are devDependencies;
  the addon is registered at `.storybook/main.js:10`. **[V]**
- `.github/workflows/qa.yml:236-272` job `storybook-test`: builds Storybook, serves `storybook-static`
  on `:6006` via `http-server`, then `node_modules/.bin/test-storybook --ci --url http://127.0.0.1:6006`.
  Note it invokes the binary directly — **there is no `test-storybook` npm script** in `package.json`,
  so locally you must run `node_modules/.bin/test-storybook` yourself. **[V]**

### 6b. What `qa.yml` gates (PRs to `develop` and `release/**` only)

| Job | Gated? | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| `unit-tests` (Vitest, `npm test`) | **Yes** | `qa.yml:207-227`; runs if any `overrides/**`, `vitest.config.*`, `vitest.setup.ts`, `tsconfig.json`, `babel.config.js` changed, or `package.json` `dependencies` changed |
| `storybook-test` (play + a11y) | **Yes** | `qa.yml:236-272`; runs if `overrides/app/{components,pages,hooks,theme,types}/**`, `.storybook/**`, or `package*.json` changed |
| `e2e-localhost` (Playwright, real SFCC dev org) | **Yes** | `qa.yml:280-409` |
| `e2e-browserstack` | Conditional | `qa.yml:427-473`; `release/**` → full suite; `develop` PR → only if an `SFCC-\d+` key appears in PR title/body/branch, `--grep`-scoped to it |
| **ESLint** | **NO** | `grep -rnE 'eslint\|npm run lint' .github/workflows/` → **zero matches across all 15 workflow files** **[V]** |
| **Prettier / `npm run format`** | **NO** | same grep, zero matches. Only local: `.claude/settings.json` PostToolUse `Write` runs `prettier --write` on newly-written files **[V]** |
| **`tsc --noEmit`** | **NO** | same grep, zero matches. It is an AGENTS.md hard requirement enforced by nobody but you **[V]** |

Git hooks in `.husky/` are `commit-msg` (conventional commits), `pre-commit` (registry regen + Contentful
drift + derived-AI-config protection + `.env.sample` secret guard), `pre-push` (tag-name validation).
**None of the three runs lint, prettier, or tsc.** **[V]**

### 6c. E2E scoping — a PDP change runs the FULL suite

`qa.yml:97-102` defines exactly one area allow-list, `e2e_homepage`. There is **no `e2e_pdp` group**,
even though 11 specs already carry `@pdp`. `qa.yml:135-146` narrows to an area only when *every*
e2e-relevant changed file falls inside that one area's list — a PDP file never does, so `e2e_scope`
falls back to `full`. That is the deliberate fail-safe direction (more tests, not fewer), not a bug —
but it means every PDP PR pays for the whole Playwright suite. Adding an `e2e_pdp` group is a cheap,
self-contained follow-up. **[V]**

### 6d. What a new PDP component is actually required to have

Per `.claude/rules/testing.md` and `.claude/rules/components.md` > Storybook **[V]**:

| Layer | Required? |
|---|---|
| `*.stories.tsx` | **Yes, always**, for anything exported from its folder under `components/` or `pages/`. Not required for a sub-component that only ever renders inside one parent. Needs a `Default` export; named exports for meaningful states only. |
| `play` fn inside the story | Only when there is interactive behaviour worth asserting (validation on blur, disclosure open/close, focus movement, controlled-input wiring). Purely visual stories need none. Query via `within(canvasElement)`, `getByRole` first. Import `userEvent`/`expect` from the Storybook re-export — `pdpProductInfo/index.stories.tsx:2` uses `from 'storybook/test'`. |
| `*.test.ts` (Vitest) | Only when failure would be non-obvious or costly: data mapping, integration boundaries, complex state, pure logic that survives a refactor invisibly. Explicitly **not** for re-exports, one-liners, or framework behaviour. `extractModelLine` is the canonical example of a "yes". |
| `.feature` + Playwright spec | For a new user journey. Gherkin first, **Lead QA signs off the `.feature` before any Playwright is written** (`.claude/skills/qa-generate/`). Tag every `test()` with both `@<area>` and `@SFCC-NNN`. |

Storybook category for PDP components: **`Commerce/`** (`components.md` > Categorisation — "Commerce-specific
shared components"). `Pages/` for the full page assembly. Titles in use today are all consistent with
the rules table **[V]**: `Commerce/PdpProductInfo`, `Pages/PDP`, `Layout/Breadcrumb`,
`Layout/PageToolbar`, `Elements/Button`. Note `zimmPageToolbar`'s story title is `Layout/PageToolbar`
(no `Zimm` prefix) while the component and folder are `ZimmPageToolbar`/`zimmPageToolbar` — follow the
same shape for new ui-kit components.

Accessibility rules are **mechanically enforced** by `.coderabbit/ast-grep-rules/` at PR review:
`<img>` needs `alt`, `IconButton` needs `aria-label`, non-interactive element with `onClick` needs
`role` (+ `tabIndex={0}` + `onKeyDown`). `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` must wrap its value in a sanitizer —
enforced by `semgrep.yml`. `pdpProductInfo/index.tsx:43,54` already does this with
`DOMPurify.sanitize(...)` from `isomorphic-dompurify`. **[V]**

---

## 7. REUSE OPPORTUNITIES

Things a PDP build should be using rather than rebuilding:

1. **`PdpProductInfo` + its theme recipe** — `overrides/app/components/pdpProductInfo/index.tsx` and
   `overrides/app/theme/components/pdpProductInfo.ts`. Name / price / sanitized description / model
   line / style code, all test-id'd, all styled through `useMultiStyleConfig`. **This is the reference
   implementation of the repo's styling convention** — copy its structure for every new PDP component.
2. **`Breadcrumb`** — `overrides/app/components/breadcrumb/index.tsx`. Wired to live `useCategory`
   data, `aria-label="Breadcrumb"`, `aria-current="page"` on the terminal crumb, `aria-hidden`
   separators, exports its own `BreadcrumbCategory` type. Import it **relatively**.
3. **`ZimmPageToolbar`** — `ui-kits/atoms/zimmPageToolbar/index.tsx`. Already has `recently-viewed`
   and `section-title` variants built and **unused**. A "You May Also Like" / "Recently Viewed" PDP
   section should use `variant="recently-viewed"` rather than a new wrapper.
4. **`extractModelLine`** — `overrides/app/utils/productData.ts`, plus its 5 passing tests.
5. **`ProductWithSizeFit`** — `overrides/app/types/commerce.ts`. Extend this file for new `c_*` fields;
   don't re-derive the Product type per component.
6. **`PDP_OPTIONS_COLUMN_WIDTH`** — exported from `product-detail/index.tsx:14` and already consumed by
   the story. Any gallery/options layout work should import it, not restate `360px`.
7. **`ProductPage` POM** — `e2e/support/pages/ProductPage.js`. Already has `goToProduct()` with the 20s
   SFCC-API gate, `selectVariant()`, `addToCart()`, `getFirstBreadcrumbCategoryLink()`, and locators for
   `product-price` / `product-description` / `product-style-code` / `product-model-info` /
   `sale-price` / `original-price` / `out-of-stock` / `cart-drawer`. **`sale-price`, `original-price`,
   `out-of-stock` and `cart-drawer` locators exist but nothing renders those test-ids yet** — they are a
   pre-agreed contract for the next PDP slice. Use those exact test-ids.
8. **SFCC-91's `pdpColourSwatches`** — 189 lines of component + 256 lines of Vitest + 204 lines of
   stories + an 883-line spec at `.docs/specs/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches.md`, plus the multi-colour
   SKU fixture in `e2e/fixtures/products.js`. **Rebase-and-adopt, do not rewrite.** Two caveats: it
   predates the `pdpProductInfo` theme-recipe refactor (rebase conflict guaranteed in
   `pdpProductInfo/index.tsx`), and it needs relocating to `ui-kits/` + a theme recipe to match convention.
9. **`.claude/rules/overrides.md`** on `origin/feature/f2r-component-registry` — the pre-flight checklist
   (default export, internal-consumer grep, `forwardRef`, Chakra deep-merge audit, prop-superset pattern,
   `vendor.d.ts` ambient rule). If PDP work overrides any SFCC component, run that checklist. Consider
   asking for it to be merged to `develop`, since `overrideStyling.md` already links to it and the link
   is currently dead.
10. **`overrides/app/utils/sfccImage.ts` — `proxyImageUrl(url)`.** **This one matters a lot for the
    gallery.** It rewrites an absolute SFCC static-asset URL to `/mobify/proxy/<path>…` by matching the
    hostname against `getConfig().ssrParameters.proxyConfigs`. Its JSDoc states the reason: direct
    browser access to the Demandware host "is typically blocked by Cloudflare WAF outside of the
    Commerce Cloud network." Any code that renders `product.imageGroups[].images[].link` **must** pass
    it through this helper or images will 403 for real shoppers. It fails open (returns the URL
    unchanged) on a relative or malformed URL. **[V]**

### Gaps the takeover should decide about explicitly

- **The gallery column is a coloured empty box** (`index.tsx:56`). Everything image-related is unbuilt.
- **`overrideStyling.md` vs `uikit-components.md`** — two mutually exclusive styling models on two
  branches (§2c). Get a ruling before writing components.
- **`ui-kits/` has one component and no rules doc on `develop`** (§2b/2c). Both `pdpProductInfo` and
  SFCC-91's `pdpColourSwatches` sit outside it. Either relocate them or stop calling ui-kits settled.
- **The story duplicates the page shell** (`index.stories.tsx:43-65` vs `index.tsx:48-88`) because
  Storybook has no `CommerceApiProvider`. Adding one to `.storybook/preview.tsx` would delete the
  duplication — but `.storybook/` is **Tier 1 frozen** (`frozenFiles.md` > Test & Tooling Config), so
  that needs Integration/SI Partner approval.
- **Error handling diverges from base**: base throws `HTTPNotFound`/`HTTPError` (`index.jsx:194-209`),
  ours renders an inline message (`index.tsx:66`). SEO consequence — a bad `productId` returns HTTP 200
  with an error string instead of a 404. AGENTS.md calls SEO a top requirement; worth raising.
- **`overrides/app/pages/product-detail/` is Squad A territory** (`.claude/rules/squadA.md:5`, draft),
  and the shared product components (`product-tile/`, `display-price/`, `image-gallery/`,
  `swatch-group/`, `recommended-products/`, `product-item/`) are **Tier 2, owned by Squad B**
  (`protectedFiles.md` > Shared Product Components). Overriding any of them crosses a squad boundary
  and needs Squad B notification; AGENTS.md Hard Rule #10 also requires stopping to confirm scope
  before touching more than one protection tier in a change.

     1	// Theme config for the PDP static product information block
     2	// (overrides/app/components/pdpProductInfo). Level 3 of the overrideStyling.md
     3	// hierarchy — all styling for the component lives here and is consumed via
     4	// useMultiStyleConfig('ZimmPdpProductInfo') → __css. Nothing is styled at the call
     5	// site except the two conditional margins noted below, which depend on which
     6	// optional props were supplied and so cannot be expressed in baseStyle.
     7	//
     8	// Levels 1 and 2 are still preferred *inside* this file: `textStyle` for typography
     9	// that has a registered token, and semantic colour/spacing token strings
    10	// ('text.default', 'l', '4xl') rather than raw values. The --zimm-* vars below are
    11	// the only level-4 escapes, each for a documented gap.
    12	
    13	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    14	// Body-font text treatment
    15	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    16	// Not a `textStyle`, deliberately: no entry in theme/foundation/typography.ts
    17	// matches this family/weight/lineHeight combination, and the weight is still
    18	// unresolved (FONT_REGULAR vs FONT_MEDIUM) pending UI-designer sign-off.
    19	//
    20	// Once the weight is confirmed, register the combination as a text style in
    21	// typography.ts (Tier 1 — UI Designer) and replace these spreads with a single
    22	// `textStyle` entry on each part, deleting these consts.
    23	const BODY_TEXT = {
    24	  fontFamily: 'var(--zimm-font-family-body)',
    25	  fontWeight: 'var(--zimm-font-weight-medium)',
    26	  lineHeight: 'var(--zimm-font-lineheight-2xs)',
    27	} as const;
    28	
    29	/** Price — same treatment as the meta copy, one step up the size scale. */
    30	const PRICE_TEXT = { ...BODY_TEXT, fontSize: 'var(--zimm-font-size-2xs)' } as const;
    31	
    32	/** Model info and style code — the smallest body size. */
    33	const META_TEXT = { ...BODY_TEXT, fontSize: 'var(--zimm-font-size-3xs)' } as const;
    34	
    35	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    36	// Conditional spacing
    37	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    38	// Applied as direct Chakra props at the call site (level 2) rather than in
    39	// baseStyle, because each collapses to 0 when the following block is absent.
    40	// The values are named here so the token lives with the rest of the styling.
    41	//
    42	// Both are numeric --zimm-scale-* aliases with no named key in spacing.ts, which
    43	// is why they are vars rather than semantic strings. Confirm against Figma and
    44	// promote to a named scale entry if either turns out to be a reusable step.
    45	
    46	/** 44px — gap between the description and the model-info / style-code group. */
    47	export const SPACE_DESCRIPTION_TO_META = 'var(--zimm-scale-1100)';
    48	
    49	/** 28px — gap between model info and style code. */
    50	export const SPACE_MODEL_INFO_TO_STYLE_CODE = 'var(--zimm-scale-700)';
    51	
    52	// Horizontal inset applied to the two prose blocks on mobile only. Semantic
    53	// spacing key (level 2), kept in one place because both parts share it.
    54	const PROSE_PADDING_RIGHT = { base: '3xl', md: 0 } as const;
    55	
    56	export const ZimmPdpProductInfo = {
    57	  parts: ['name', 'price', 'description', 'modelInfo', 'styleCode'],
    58	  baseStyle: {
    59	    name: {
    60	      textStyle: 'heading3',
    61	      color: 'text.default',
    62	      marginBottom: 'l',
    63	    },
    64	
    65	    price: {
    66	      ...PRICE_TEXT,
    67	      color: 'text.default',
    68	      marginBottom: 'l',
    69	    },
    70	
    71	    // Renders sanitized CMS/PIM HTML — see the DOMPurify call at the call site.
    72	    description: {
    73	      textStyle: 'body2',
    74	      color: 'text.default',
    75	      paddingRight: PROSE_PADDING_RIGHT,
    76	    },
    77	
    78	    // Also sanitized HTML. marginBottom is supplied at the call site.
    79	    modelInfo: {
    80	      ...META_TEXT,
    81	      color: 'text.default',
    82	      paddingRight: PROSE_PADDING_RIGHT,
    83	    },
    84	
    85	    styleCode: {
    86	      ...META_TEXT,
    87	      color: 'text.secondary',
    88	      marginBottom: '4xl',
    89	    },
    90	  },
    91	};

### Verdict
The branch **skipped all of §2 (Before you write any code) and most of §8 (Before you open a PR), and executed §3 (Design Foundations) better than anything else in the repo.** That explains the PR's shape exactly: an exemplary component layer sitting on an integration layer that reproduces every failure the skipped steps exist to prevent.

### Three loud corrections to the record

1. **The brief's premise about `auditTokenUsage.mjs` is wrong.** The script indeed doesn't exist (VERIFIED — `ls scripts/`), but the **manual does not mandate it**. Its §8 command block (lines 875–881) lists five commands and this isn't one; line 924 already documents the script as missing.
